This project is in cooperation with **Nekomoe kissaten**. Thanks to them for elaborating Chinese subtitles.

原盘画质一般，原生分辨率为 864p。线条有轻微的锯齿和振铃，暗场有较严重的色带，平面有明显的欠码现象，特别是噪点被压得很难看。我们进行了逆向拉伸重构、去色带、补偿性锐化。然后削弱了原盘被压烂的噪点，替换为同等强度的动态噪点以改善观感。最后为了控制体积，我们进行了自适应降噪。
The source quality is average, with a native resolution of 864p. There are several artifacts: slight aliasing and ringing around the lines, serious colour banding in the dark scenes and obviously insufficient bitrate of the flat area, especially featuring the DCT noise. We first adopted descaling and reconstruction, de-banding and compensatory sharpening. The DCT noise was then weakened and replaced with dynamic grains of equal intensity to improve the viewing experience. Finally, we performed adaptive denoising to control the bitrate.
